mgmt_bio.text: Enrique K. Razon Jr. leads International Container Terminal Services, Inc. (ICTSI) as chairman and chief executive, a role the company describes as chairman of the board and president. He has been a director of ICTSI since December 1987 and its chairman since 1995. ICTSI was incorporated in 1987 by the Razon and Soriano groups to bid for the Manila International Container Terminal, and after the 1988 contract win Razon led the terminal's development program. ICTSI today manages and operates ports and terminals across roughly 20 countries. Alongside ICTSI, he is chairman and chief executive of Bloomberry Resorts Corporation and Manila Water Company, and chairman of Prime Strategic Holdings and several other Razon-linked firms. Born in Manila on March 3, 1960, he studied at De La Salle University.

thesis_pillars.text: Acquisitions are driving growth, with first-half 2026 throughput up 16 percent to 8.12 million TEUs, led by newly acquired terminals in South Africa and Indonesia. Profitability is high and improving, with H1 2026 port revenue up 27 percent to 1.92 billion dollars, EBITDA up 24 percent to 1.23 billion and attributable net income up 22 percent. A funded capacity pipeline supports future volumes: about 740 million dollars of 2026 capital spending for expansion and equipment, backed by a 1 billion dollar ten-year BDO Unibank loan. Long concession tenure underpins the core asset, as the Manila International Container Terminal concession was extended by 25 years to 2063.
